title: Original MFC module state lookup and checked local allocation

0x546a90.name: TlsAlloc
0x546a90.reason: Physical TLS-index allocation returns a distinct live index or 0xffffffff on exhaustion.

0x546a7c.name: TlsGetValue
0x546a7c.reason: Physical TLS lookup uses both the current thread and allocated index, returning the stored pointer or null.

0x546a84.name: TlsSetValue
0x546a84.reason: Physical TLS publication stores the exact container pointer only on success; a failed return leaves TLS unchanged.

0x546aa4.name: InitializeCriticalSection
0x546aa4.reason: Physical initialization of the exact 24-byte critical-section record, with nonreturning service exceptions.

0x546aac.name: EnterCriticalSection
0x546aac.reason: Physical lock acquisition tracks section identity, owner and recursion.

0x546a9c.name: LeaveCriticalSection
0x546a9c.reason: Physical lock release balances the current owner and section.

0x546b1c.name: GlobalAlloc
0x546b1c.reason: Physical movable global allocation preserves exact flags and separate handle/data identities; failure returns null.

0x546a8c.name: GlobalHandle
0x546a8c.reason: Physical conversion from a global data pointer to its handle also accepts null on initial allocation failure.

0x5469c8.name: GlobalUnlock
0x5469c8.reason: Physical handle unlock decrements its lock count; zero can be a successful final unlock.

0x546a88.name: GlobalReAlloc
0x546a88.reason: Physical movable global reallocation preserves the prefix and preserves old ownership on failure.

0x5469c4.name: GlobalLock
0x5469c4.reason: Physical handle lock returns its data pointer; the cached IAT target remains this same physical import.

0x546aa8.name: LocalAlloc
0x546aa8.reason: Physical local allocation returns live memory or null; flags 0x40 zero bytes, while flags zero do not promise initialized contents.

0x546a80.name: LocalReAlloc
0x546a80.reason: Physical fixed-block reallocation with flags 2 preserves the old prefix and keeps the old allocation alive on failure.

0x546958.name: RaiseException
0x546958.reason: Physical noncontinuable exception boundary: flags 1 must Halt without returning, reached through unchanged original throw helpers; no exception dispatch is fabricated.

0x546abc.name: GetVersion
0x546abc.reason: Physical compatibility-version service used by original singleton-lock initialization; MFC constructors remain original.
